title: Koszul Orlik--Solomon Algebras from Non-supersolvable Arrangements
summary: The cohomology ring of the complement of a complex hyperplane arrangement is given by its Orlik--Solomon algebra. It is known that the defining ideal of the Orlik--Solomon algebra has a quadratic Gröbner basis in the standard presentation if and only if the intersection lattice is supersolvable; such algebras are automatically Koszul. In 1997, Shelton and Yuzvinsky posed the question as to whether all Koszul Orlik--Solomon algebras arise from supersolvable arrangements.
